content.label: Full journey abroad
content.title: Full journey abroad
content.summary: 4 workshops over about nine months. The main workshop takes place over a week abroad, and the rest in Israel.

workshops.title: Opening workshop
workshops.text: A day and a half, including an overnight stay: from Thursday at around 17:30 until Friday at 14:00.

workshops.title: The main workshop
workshops.text: A week abroad, hosted by a Jewish community. Accommodation with host families.

workshops.title: Closing workshop
workshops.text: About a month and a half after the main workshop. Friday, 8:00 to 14:00, usually in a forest in the Jerusalem area.

workshops.title: Follow-up workshop
workshops.text: About 6 months after the closing workshop. About six hours, in the evening.

content.label: Full journey in Israel
content.title: Full journey in Israel
content.summary: 4 workshops over about nine months. The main workshop takes place over five days at a secluded location in Israel.

workshops.title: Opening workshop
workshops.text: One day: Friday, from morning until the afternoon.

workshops.title: The main workshop
workshops.text: Five days at a secluded location in Israel, with work both indoors and outdoors.

workshops.title: Closing workshop
workshops.text: About a month after the main workshop. Friday, 8:00 to 14:00, usually in a forest in the Jerusalem area.

workshops.title: Follow-up workshop
workshops.text: About 6 months after the closing workshop. About six hours, in the evening.

content.label: Short journey in Israel
content.title: Short journey in Israel
content.summary: 3 workshops over about two months. The main workshop takes place over three days at a secluded location in Israel.

workshops.title: Opening workshop
workshops.text: One day: Friday, from morning until the afternoon.

workshops.title: The main workshop
workshops.text: Three days (Tuesday to Thursday) at a secluded location in Israel, with work both indoors and outdoors.

workshops.title: Closing workshop
workshops.text: About a month after the main workshop. Friday, 8:00 to 14:00, usually in a forest in the Jerusalem area.
